function: Predicts the precoding matrix (SVD precoder) of the next sounding period from past precoding matrices, to reduce pilot and feedback overhead (p. 1-2).
system: Single-cell downlink FDD MIMO-OFDM: BS with 64 dual-polarized antennas, one UE with 4 antennas, 2 streams; 3.5 GHz, 100 MHz; no RIS (p. 1, 3).
method: TFNET: parallel LSTM (time) and residual CNN (frequency) blocks fused by summation; unsupervised training with a channel-capacity loss, no labels (p. 2-3).
data_channel: Self-generated CDL-C channels (MATLAB cluster delay line function) at 3.5 GHz, UE speed 20 m/s; 5000 training, 1000 validation, 1000 test samples (p. 3, 5).
test_conditions: Training, validation and test sets come from one CDL-C simulation at 20 m/s; only time order and NRB count vary (p. 3-5).
baselines: Zero-order hold, autoregressive prediction plus SVD, genie SVD; learned variants of TFNET: 3D CNN replacing LSTM and CNN blocks, CAT and MUL fusion (p. 4-5).
metrics: Channel capacity achieved with the predicted PM, reported as accuracy gain G over zero-order hold; FLOPs; pilot overhead; combined metric E (p. 4).
complexity: FLOPs: 8,097,792 for n=8, k=2 and 1,213,956,096 for n=68, k=10, with per-layer FLOP formulas for LSTM, CNN and FC layers (p. 4).
openness: none; data generated with the MATLAB CDL function, no code or data link given (p. 3).
q1_support: p. 3: "We generate the dataset produced by the cluster delay line (CDL) model function of the MATLAB API." Table I lists the delay profile CDL-C, a 3GPP TR 38.901 profile (the paper does not cite the TR number).
q2_support: p. 5: "The size of training, validation, and test sets are set to 5000, 1000, and 1000 respectively." All sets come from one CDL-C dataset (p. 3); only time order and NRB count are varied, no other channel, speed, band or array is tested.
q3_support: p. 5: "We remove the LSTM block and CNN block from TFNET and replace them with a 3D CNN block." 3DCNN, CAT and MUL are variants of TFNET; zero-order hold and autoregression are non-learned, but no earlier learned PM or CSI predictor ([8]-[13]) is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total amount of FLOPs for the model is 8, 097, 792" for n=8, k=2, and 1,213,956,096 for n=68, k=10, with FLOP formulas (7)-(9) per layer type.
q5_support: p. 3: "We generate the dataset produced by the cluster delay line (CDL) model function of the MATLAB API." The data are self-generated; no code or data link is given and no public dataset or measurement is used.
notes: Area 2: the network predicts the precoding matrix (right singular vectors of the channel) from past PMs to cut pilot and feedback overhead (p. 1); if the reviewer reads the output as the BS precoder, area 3. CDL-C is a 3GPP TR 38.901 profile generated with MATLAB; the paper does not cite the TR number (p. 3). q3 is borderline: the 3D CNN baseline is TFNET with its LSTM and CNN blocks replaced (p. 5), so it is treated as a variant; no earlier learned predictor is compared.
